settings.allowOverUsageHint: When enabled, accounts will continue to serve requests even after their quota is exhausted
settings.modelCatalogAuto: Auto — forwarding routes if any are on, otherwise Kiro accounts
settings.modelCatalogBoth: Both — forwarding routes first, then Kiro accounts
settings.modelCatalogHint: Forwarding-only hides account models from the list and returns 404 for names that are not an enabled route. Target rewrite names are never listed. Applies immediately.
settings.thinkingSuffixHint: Add this suffix to model name to enable thinking mode, e.g. claude-sonnet-4.5-thinking
settings.defaultEffortHint: Applied when a request asks for thinking without naming a level. A level sent by the client always wins. Kiro has no upstream effort field, so this steers the model via the prompt rather than enforcing a token budget.
settings.advertiseEffortModelsHint: Adds one "(level)" variant per model so clients can pick depth from the model list. Multiplies the listing by 5; leave off if your client renders every entry in a picker.
settings.endpointHint: Select preferred endpoint. In auto-select mode, the endpoint is automatically selected based on availability.
settings.endpointFallbackHint: When disabled, only the selected endpoint is used without automatic fallback
settings.adminAllowlistPlaceholder:

settings.adminAllowlistHint: Restricts /admin access to these IPs/CIDRs. Empty = allow all. Localhost is always allowed.
settings.trustProxyHint: Only enable when Kiro sits behind a trusted reverse proxy. Otherwise client IPs can be spoofed.
settings.tlsHint: Set both paths to serve HTTPS. Empty = plain HTTP. Requires a restart.
settings.tlsRestartHint: TLS changes take effect after a restart.

proxyImport.formatHint: Supported: host:port, host:port:user:pass, host:port|user|pass, user:pass@host:port, or a full scheme:// URL.
proxyImport.autoTest: Test each account end-to-end after assigning
proxyImport.dryRun: Dry run (parse & probe only, do not assign)
proxyImport.listRequired: Please paste at least one proxy

settings.filterEnvNoiseHint: Removes injected env vars, git status, recent commits and similar noise from system prompts.
settings.filterStripBoundariesHint: Strips --- SYSTEM PROMPT --- / --- END SYSTEM PROMPT --- marker lines.

memory.title: Memory (Mem0)
memory.intro: Optional long-term memory sidecar backed by a self-hosted Mem0 server. Off by default. Stores and retrieves memories through a dedicated admin API; it does not inject memory into the LLM request path.
memory.enabledHint: When off, no calls are made to the backend. Requires a base URL to activate.
memory.baseURLHint: Self-hosted Mem0 server root, e.g. http://localhost:8888
memory.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the stored key
memory.apiKeyHint: Sent as X-Api-Key. Stored masked; leave empty to keep the current key unchanged.
memory.writeModeAutomaticWarning: Automatic mode captures conversation content. Coding sessions routinely contain API keys, .env files and private source. Secret redaction and the source-code guard still apply, but review your retention and scope before enabling.
memory.injectHint: When on, relevant memories for the caller are retrieved and prepended to the request before it reaches the model. Off by default.
memory.maxInjectTokensHint: Upper bound on the injected memory block so it cannot crowd out the conversation. Defaults to 1200.
memory.redactSecretsHint: Masks obvious credentials (API keys, bearer tokens) before a memory is written. Recommended on.
memory.storeSourceCodeHint: When off, candidates that look like source dumps (large code blocks, diffs, .env) are dropped. Recommended off.
memory.failOpenHint: When on, a memory outage degrades silently (recall returns empty, writes are dropped) instead of surfacing an error.

apiKeys.requireWithoutEnabledKeyWarning: No enabled API key found (legacy keys migrated from older configs are kept disabled). Enabling authentication now will reject every /v1/* request. Enable or create a key first — continue anyway?

apiKeys.showWarning: Copy and store this key now. It will not be shown in plaintext again.
apiKeys.enforceStrict: Stored only — token/credit stay soft in V1
apiKeys.enforceHint: Request limits are always reserved exactly. Token and credit limits are usage-based (soft) even if Strict is stored.
apiKeys.confirmRotate: Rotate secret for "{0}"? The old secret stops working immediately.
apiKeys.formCountHint: Creates 1–100 keys with the same quota. Names become prefix-01, prefix-02, …
apiKeys.batchShowWarning: Copy and store these keys now. They will not be shown in plaintext again.

upstreams.intro: Forward selected models to any external OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint (9router, LiteLLM, or any custom provider) instead of the Kiro account pool. Clients keep pointing at this proxy — no client config changes needed.
upstreams.providersHint: External endpoints requests can be forwarded to.
upstreams.routesHint: Map a client model name to a provider. Matching is exact. Important: routed model names must NOT overlap with the model names the upstream calls back into this proxy, or requests will loop.
upstreams.baseUrlHint: Include the version path, e.g. http://localhost:20128/v1 or https://your-provider.com/v1. Running in Docker? Use host.docker.internal instead of localhost to reach a service on the host machine.
upstreams.apiKeyHint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer to the upstream. Leave a masked value unchanged to keep the stored key.
upstreams.proxyUrlHint: Per-provider outbound proxy; falls back to the global proxy when empty.
upstreams.routeModelHint: The model name clients send. Matched exactly.
upstreams.targetModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the same name
upstreams.targetModelHint: Rewrite the model field before forwarding. Pick a suggestion, type your own, or leave empty to keep the original name.
upstreams.routeTargetsHint: Tried tier by tier, top first. A request moves on only when the previous target fails before sending any reply — connection errors, 429, or 5xx. Reorder to switch provider without losing the old setup; tick “same tier as above” to split traffic by weight instead of failing over.
upstreams.routeTargetWeightHint: Share of traffic among targets in the same tier. Leave at 1 for an even split.
upstreams.routeTargetSameTierHint: Put this target at the same priority as the one above instead of using it as a fallback. Targets sharing a tier split traffic by weight.
upstreams.routeTargetWeightInert: Weight only applies when two or more targets share a tier. Tick “same tier as above” to split traffic.
upstreams.kiroPoolTargetHint: Serves the request from this instance's own Kiro account pool instead of forwarding it. Reaching this target ends the chain, so put it last to use the pool as a fallback.
upstreams.routeTargetUnreachableHint: The Kiro Pool target above ends the chain, so this target is never tried. Move it above the pool row to make it reachable.
upstreams.routeTargetTestHint: Send a one-token probe to this target ({0})
upstreams.routeTargetTestPoolHint: The Kiro Pool target is answered locally, so there is no upstream endpoint to probe.
upstreams.routeTargetTestNoModel: Nothing to probe: fill in Client Model, or a Target Model on this row.
upstreams.routeTargetHiddenHint: Hidden from this list only. The target keeps its place in the priority order.
upstreams.routeTargetHiddenLive: Hidden but still enabled — it keeps its slot in the chain and keeps receiving traffic.
upstreams.routeTargetAllHidden: Every target on this route is hidden.
upstreams.routeChainHiddenHint: Hidden in the route editor, still routed: {0}
upstreams.hiddenHint: Hidden from the list. This does not stop forwarding.
upstreams.hiddenStillLive: Hidden but still enabled — it keeps receiving forwards.
upstreams.importDesc: Paste or choose a config file exported from the Forwarding tab. The exported file contains provider API keys in plain text — keep it secret. Existing entries are never overwritten: a provider that already exists (same base URL and name) is skipped and keeps its current API key, and a route whose client model is already routed is skipped. As with adding routes by hand, routed model names must not overlap with the model names the upstream calls back into this proxy, or requests will loop.
upstreams.importEmpty: Choose a file or paste the config JSON first
upstreams.importSummary: Providers: {0} added, {1} skipped · Routes: {2} added, {3} skipped
upstreams.connectionsEmpty: No API keys yet. Add one or bulk-import credentials.

upstreams.connApiKeyHint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. The raw key is never shown again after save.
upstreams.connApiKeyHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the stored key. Enter a new value to rotate it.

stats.title: Provider Statistics
stats.intro: Compare every provider side by side, including the Kiro account pool. Click a row to drill into models, accounts, errors and throughput.
stats.confirmResetProvider: Reset all statistics for {0}? Other providers keep their data. This cannot be undone.
stats.orphanHint: This provider is no longer configured, but its recorded history is kept.
stats.windowNote: Figures cover the selected range. Live signals (in-flight, failure streak, last used) are current. Ranges under 2 hours use in-memory data and refill after a restart.
stats.trendMinuteNote: Per-minute data is kept in memory only and resets when the proxy restarts.
stats.topIpsIntro: Source IPs ranked by request volume. Requires an IP to be resolvable; behind a proxy, enable Trust Proxy so the real client IP is used.
stats.topIpsProxyOn: Trust Proxy on: using X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP
stats.cmpLogNote: Log scale: values are very unevenly spread.
stats.cmpCostNote: Only providers with pricing configured. The Kiro pool is metered in credits and cannot be compared here.
stats.cmpNeedTwo: Comparison appears once at least two providers have handled requests.
